reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`-boltdb.shipper.compactor.shared-store`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The `--boltdb.shipper.compactor.shared-store` flag will no longer be recognized or honored by the compactor component; any configuration using this flag will be ignored during upgrade to Loki 3.0.0.

proposed.statement: The `-boltdb.shipper.compactor.shared-store` CLI flag was removed in Loki 3.0.0.
